title: Basic agent
what: Creates a minimal assistant backed by the OpenAI provider.
how: Builds an Agent with a model configuration and sends it a prompt, showing the smallest useful agent setup.

title: Ollama agent
what: Connects an agent to a model served locally by Ollama.
how: Sets the local provider and model name, then sends a prompt through the same Agent interface.

title: Function tools
what: Gives a financial assistant a compound interest calculator.
how: Defines a Python function with typed arguments and registers it so the agent can call it for a calculation.

title: Tool approval
what: Requires approval before a tool saves a report to a file.
how: Defines a file saving tool and configures approval for the tool call before it runs.

title: Sessions
what: Continues a conversation across separate runs.
how: Runs the agent with the same user and session identifiers so conversation context can be restored.

title: Memory
what: Stores and reuses a user preference with local memory.
how: Configures a local memory backend and uses the same user identity on later runs to recall saved information.

title: Knowledge search
what: Lets an assistant search local reference documents.
how: Creates a local knowledge collection and connects it to the agent for retrieval relevant to the prompt.

title: Structured output
what: Returns data validated against a Pydantic model.
how: Defines a response schema and asks the agent to produce a result that conforms to its fields.

title: MCP tools
what: Connects an agent to tools exposed by an HTTP MCP server.
how: Configures the MCP server connection and makes its available tools usable during the agent run.

title: Skills
what: Adds a repository skill to a writing assistant.
how: Loads a skill from the project and includes it in the agent configuration so its instructions guide the task.

title: Streaming events
what: Prints an agent response as it arrives.
how: Consumes the run event stream and displays text chunks as the model produces them.

title: Middleware and tracing
what: Logs run activity and can emit traces through an OpenTelemetry provider.
how: Adds middleware around the agent run; tracing is available when a telemetry provider is configured.

title: Workspace files
what: Creates a file in a user-specific workspace.
how: Configures workspace access and asks the agent to write a file, keeping its files scoped to the user.

title: Concurrent runs
what: Serves two users concurrently with one agent configuration.
how: Starts independent asynchronous runs with separate user context so their conversations remain distinct.

title: Full agent
what: Combines tools, memory, knowledge, skills, and sessions in one assistant.
how: Builds a complete configuration from the smaller capabilities and runs an agent with the combined setup.

title: Native tool
what: Implements a compound interest calculator as a native framework tool.
how: Extends CoreTool, defines its input schema and execution method, then registers the tool with an agent.

title: PostgreSQL memory
what: Shows a minimal memory backend stored in PostgreSQL.
how: Implements the memory registry interface with database operations for storing and retrieving user memories.

title: PostgreSQL knowledge
what: Demonstrates a small PostgreSQL-backed knowledge registry for office notes.
how: The url constructor argument supplies the PostgreSQL connection string. On connect, the example creates an example_knowledge table and inserts one sample office-hours note. Search runs a parameterized ILIKE query with a result limit, then returns matching rows as KnowledgeBlock objects. This minimal example uses text matching; it does not implement embeddings or semantic search.

title: Custom middleware
what: Observes when an agent run starts and finishes.
how: Extends CoreMiddleware and implements lifecycle hooks that receive the run context and final response.

title: In-memory session store
what: Implements session persistence with a Python dictionary.
how: Extends CoreSessionStore and defines async load and save operations keyed by user and session.

title: Custom prompt layer
what: Adds a reusable English style instruction to an agent.
how: Defines a CoreLayer component that contributes instructions to the prompt stack.

title: Custom embedding
what: Provides a small teaching embedding implementation based on word counts.
how: Extends CoreEmbedding and maps input text to vectors, demonstrating the embedding interface without a remote model.

title: Custom workspace
what: Stores workspace files in a local folder that represents an alternate backend.
how: Extends WorkspaceBase and implements download and upload behavior between workspace files and the configured folders.

title: Serialize an agent
what: Saves an agent configuration as JSON.
how: Creates an Agent and serializes its configuration so it can be stored and restored later.

title: Deserialize an agent
what: Rebuilds an agent from previously saved JSON.
how: Loads serialized configuration and passes it to the framework to reconstruct the Agent.
